user.account.title: My Account

user.authorize.heading: Connect {client} to Astrum Repository?

user.form.emailRule: Enter an address such as jane@example.org

user.nugetKey.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
user.nugetKey.intro: Access your NuGet API key to authenticate NuGet package manager clients against this Astrum Repository instance.
user.nugetKey.keepSecret: Keep this key secret. Store it in your NuGet configuration, not in source code.
user.nugetKey.resetDone: API key reset. Generate a new one.
user.nugetKey.resetFailed: Could not reset the NuGet API key. Check your credentials.
user.nugetKey.resetText: This will permanently invalidate your current NuGet API key. Any NuGet clients using the existing key will fail to authenticate. You can generate a new key after resetting.

user.nugetKey.title: NuGet API Key
user.password.changed: Your password is changed. Your other sessions have ended.

user.password.intro.other: Choose a new password for your account. It needs at least {count} characters.

user.password.same: Choose a password other than the current one
user.password.title: Change Password
user.password.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.

user.tokens.emptyAll: Nobody has an access token yet.

user.tokens.name: Name
user.tokens.namePlaceholder: such as Jenkins on the build host
user.tokens.noMatches: No access token matches your search.
user.tokens.once: Copy the token now. It is shown this one time only; if you lose it, create another one.
user.tokens.passwordFirst: You signed in with an access token. Tokens can only be created, listed and revoked after signing in with your password, so a leaked token cannot make more of itself.
user.tokens.passwordFirstTitle: Sign in with your password first
user.tokens.revokeText: Clients that use “{name}” stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
user.tokens.scopeWriteText: Everything you can do yourself, publishing included

user.tokens.usageText: Sign in with your username as before and give the token instead of the password. Put the name of your repository in place of <repository>.
